{{Quote|Chiloon may be outside Alliance space, but that doesn't mean we have no interest there. The Rift supplies a tenth of our beryllius, a quarter of our quadranium, and most of our duralium. And the list of other minerals is as long as my arm.|Luewet Wuul|<ref name="Crucible" />}}
The '''Chiloon Rift''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] that contained one of the largest and most bountiful [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid fields]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. There were many unclaimed asteroids filled with valuable minerals in the rift, and it was a place of opportunity for [[Miner/Legends|miners]] by [[45 ABY]]. However, clouds of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] and its field of asteroids made it difficult to navigate, and a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] needed quick reflexes to avoid obstacles and land on worlds within the rift.

==History==
{{Quote|But he was about to introduce a bill authorizing military action to stop mineral smuggling from the Chiloon Rift, so of course there's talk of an assassination. Like any politician, Wuul had enemies.|[[Mirta Gev]]|<ref name="Crucible" />}}
The draw of resources brought many individuals to the rift, and many [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] bands established operations there. As a result, the Chiloon Rift was a dangerous place to operate, but the opportunity for great wealth still led individuals to flock to the nebula. The Chiloon Rift was outside of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]], but it still had financial ties to the nebula, receiving large shipments of [[beryllius]], [[Duralium/Legends|duralium]], [[Quadranium/Legends|quadranium]], and other minerals.
The Rift was located midway between the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] and the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], but was considered to be within the Imperial Remnant sphere of influence, being much closer than the Corporate Sector Authority. However, neither attempted to annex the nebula, due to the fiercely independent nature of the miners operating on asteroids within the Rift and believed that any attempt to conquer the rift would result in a prolonged engagement with the miners at an advantage with the ability to hide within the asteroid belt.

In [[45 ABY]], the nebula was the site of increased mining activity, and opportunistic businesspeople struggled to acquire as much of the rift as possible. The [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers, [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]] slowly began to arrest financial control of the nebula, using dirty business tactics to eliminate competitors. Additionally, they used their financial influence to manipulate the Galactic Alliance, which was planning to intervene in the rift to stop mineral smuggling. They hired the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[Vestara Khai|Savara Raine]] to eliminate the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Luewet Wuul]], who was planning to introduce a bill that would involve the Alliance in the rift. Wuul's death kept the Alliance from intervening in the nebula, allowing the Qrephs to gain further control.

Their dealings eventually led them into conflict with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who had a [[Sarnus Refinery|refinery]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarnus]] within the rift. Despite threats and a generous offer for his holdings, Calrissian refused to sell. The Qreph brothers had designs on the rift beyond simple financial gain, and although Calrissian attempted to negotiate to split control of the Chiloon Rift, the Qreph brothers were uncooperative. They instead [[Destruction of Sarnus Refinery|attacked]] the Sarnus Refinery, killing many of Calrissian's employees and causing open conflict within the rift. Using his contacts within the Galactic Alliance and the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]], Calrissian decided to take [[Assault on Base Prime|the fight]] to the Qrephs at their headquarters, [[Base Prime]]. The attack resulted in the deaths of the Qreph brothers, halting their attempt to take control of the Chiloon Rift.
